pages.name: Two Knights: Fritz, Paoli's 8.h4
pages.notes: Overview said Black had a gambit pawn and that 8.h4 stops ...Ng4; material is level and h4 defends the g5-knight against the d8-queen. Plan 3 played d2-d4 onto Black's d4-knight; plan 4 had ...h6 challenging h4. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Two Knights: Traxler, 5.Nxf7 & 6.Kf1, Palkin Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 played ...Bh3 (pawn on h3) and ...Ne6-g5; plan 4 sent the king to g1 and h2, which the f2-bishop covers. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Two Knights: Traxler, 5.Nxf7 & 6.Kxf2
pages.notes: Plan 2 sent the king to h1, where White's own rook stands, and missed the ...Qf2# threat. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Two Knights: Traxler, Chigorin/Pithart Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 relied on a ...d5 break, impossible with White's bishop on d5; rewritten around ...Rf8, ...d6 and ...Bg4 (reviewer rejected the first wording, which put the rook against f2 through the f6-knight; fixed and accepted). Overview notes the half-open f-file. British spelling.

pages.name: Italian Game: Two Knights Defense, Colman Variation
pages.notes: Overview did not say that 8...Rb8 attacks the b5-bishop; plan 3 reworded so the a5-knight route to c4 parses as Black's. British spelling.

pages.name: Italian Game: Two Knights Defense, Maróczy Variation
pages.notes: Plan 4 rerouted an a5-knight that has already been exchanged on c4; plan 1 had White castling queenside for a g4-g5 storm. Overview and all plans rewritten around the extra d5-pawn, doubled c-pawns, bishop pair and the e4-pawn hitting f3. British spelling.

pages.name: Italian Game: Two Knights Defense, Polerio Defense, Bogoljubow Variation
pages.notes: Plan 4 said ...h6 prevents Ng5-h7; rewritten to the real choices (8...Rb8, 8...h6, ...cxb5 allowing Qxa8). Overview made concrete. British spelling.

pages.name: Italian Game: Two Knights Defense, Polerio Defense, Yankovich Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 used a d4-pawn that does not exist; plan 2 had Black pressuring its own e4-pawn; plan 3 rerouted the knight f1-g3; plan 4 rerouted an a5-knight already exchanged. All plans and the overview rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Two Knights Defence: Morphy, Polerio, 6...Bd7
pages.notes: Plan 2 relied on ...c6 and ...bxc6 without White's dxc6; overview said Bd7 challenges the bishop. Rewritten around the pin on d7 and the e2-queen hitting e5. British spelling.

pages.name: Two Knights Defence:Morphy Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 played ...Nb7-d6 with Black's own pawn on b7; plan 1 ignored ...e4 and the attack on the c4-bishop. Overview and plans 1-2 rewritten around 7...e4 8.Qe2 Nxc4 9.dxc4. British spelling.
